result.title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
result.summary: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names and image targets that would expose reasoning shortcuts while retaining necessary disambiguating clues, yielding text-only, image-initialized, and arbitrarily interleaved multi-hop problems. We train the ModalSearcher Agent with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment, and construct ModalSearch-Bench. Experiments show that ModalSearcher-8B improves average accuracy by 16.2 points over Qwen3-VL-8B under the same agentic workflow across five multimodal knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, with consistent gains on independently constructed active visual-search benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多模态大模型在知识密集任务中的「自主跨模态搜索」：提出构造交错多模态知识图谱与多跳问题（text-only、图像起始、任意交错）的流水线，在真实 Web 环境中用 SFT 与 RL 训练搜索 agent，并构建 ModalSearch-Bench；8B 模型在五个多模态知识密集 QA 基准上平均提升 16.2 分。
AI.relevance_reason: agent 需在多跳中判断何时引入视觉证据、在推理／文搜／图搜／反查间切换，直接关联「LOOK 的收益与成本」和视觉证据筛选，可供核查其模态切换策略与停止决策的评价方式；但推理状态体现于外显搜索轨迹而非 latent 状态，与 LVR 主线仍有距离。
